decision.statement: Rely on this swarm run's outcomes, measured at the receivers, as a verified run of configuration A (receipts and allowlists)

resources: the desk services: records, ledger, mail, cache

limitations_permitted: The services are synthetic and run inside the harness process; the receivers are the reference receiver, journaled in memory and published
The gate clock is accepted as the dispatch time
Demonstration keys, when used, prove the mechanism, not identity
rejection_criteria: Any tool call not on the allowed list that the gate allowed
Any gap in a receipt chain
Any receiver decision that does not verify
Any outcome that does not recompute from the journals
hold_criteria: A harness other than the pinned one
A run whose environment attestation is missing

consequence.if_met: Listed as a verified swarm run: the outcomes stand on the journals and the receipts, not on any agent's report.

enforcement.tool: records.get, ledger.pay, mail.send, cache.put, cache.get, cache.list, done
